behavior: Only canonical matching-model HTTP400 Codex entitlement denial, optionally exact internal [400] prefix, learns a hint.
Hint keys SHA256-bind database, selection import generation, actual credential/account identity and normalized wire-model lock family; entries contain only expiry and persistent import revision.
Post-await row, generation, signal, credential identity and persistent import revision checks prevent stale hint publication/deletion.
Denied preference is applied after genuine quota/lock/exclusion eligibility; denied-only eligible pools probe upstream.
Attempt context is captured before proactive refresh; original selection generation survives accepted refresh.
Codex stale-success context blocks all hint and health cleanup; transaction write fence covers subsequent import/re-auth race.
Hint cap500, TTL30minutes exact boundary; no raw credentials or upstream body retained.

After an awaited lookup, stale-entry invalidation deletes only the captured entry; successful completion deletes only a hint matching its attempt import revision, preventing newer concurrent publication from being erased.
